records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2023 were $140.0 million, as compared to $144.6 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our inventory was in a healthy position at quarter-end, down 9.5% as compared to July 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter of fiscal 2023, our gross margin rate, inclusive of occupancy costs, was 50.3% as compared to a gross margin rate of 52.1% for the second quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter and first six months of fiscal 2022, we recognized a tax benefit of $35.1 million and $35.0 million, respectively, which reflects the release of approximately $35.5 million, or $0.53 per diluted share, in valuation allowance against our deferred tax assets, partially offset by income tax expense of $0.4 million and $0.5 million, respectively, in states where our usage of net operating losses ("NOL") is limited.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Compelling two-year stacked comparable sales: For the second quarter, total Chico’s FAS comparable sales decreased 3.0% versus last year’s second quarter and increased 16.5% on a two-year stacked basis.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Chico’s comparable sales decreased 2.5% versus the second quarter last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the end of the second quarter, inventories totaled $300.2 million compared to $338.8 million at the end of last year’s second quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For all three brands, full-priced sales remained healthy, and year-over-year total Company average dollar spend and units per transaction increased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Strong operating income: Second quarter income from operations was $46.5 million, or 8.5% of net sales, reflecting solid gross margin performance combined with continued, disciplined expense management and investment in the Company’s growth strategies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $27.8 million, or 2.4%, for the three months ended July 29, 2023 compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended July 29, 2023, net sales in our Europe, Australia, and Canada segments increased by 28.3%, 9.0%, and 5.9% compared to the prior year, while net sales in our United States segment decreased by 4.2% compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities during the six months ended July 30, 2022 was primarily due to a decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities related to overhead and inventory, as well as the impact of our net loss.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Improving margins through operational discipline and increased emphasis on higher margin collectibles and pre-owned product categories;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the six months ended July 29, 2023, cash flows from operating activities were an outflow of $211.8 million, compared with an outflow of $407.3 million during the same period last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our sales are typically higher in our second quarter, which usually includes most of our Anniversary Sale, and in the fourth quarter due to the holidays.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenues recognized from our beginning contract liability balance were $131 and $218 for the quarter and six months ended July 29, 2023 and $119 and $197 for the quarter and six months ended July 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of July 29, 2023, we had total short-term borrowing capacity of $800 and no outstanding borrowings under the Revolver that expires in May 2027.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We repurchased 0.03 shares of common stock for $1 at an average purchase price per share of $19.41 during the six months ended July 29, 2023, compared with 1.5 shares for $35 at an average purchase price per share of $23.17 during the six months ended of July 30, 2022, and had $438 remaining in share repurchase capacity as of July 29, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Second quarter results reflected continued progress on our 2023 key priorities of improving Nordstrom Rack performance, increasing our inventory productivity and optimizing our supply chain capabilities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce net sales, decreased $187.3 million, or 14.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net sales was primarily driven by a 14.6% decrease in our comps, which decreased net sales by $187.3 million and our non-comparable sales, which decreased net sales by $19.6 million, driven by the net decrease of 20 stores since the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Inventory decreased by 15.2%, or $175.8 million, from $1,159.0 million at the end of the second quarter of 2022 to $983.2 million at the end of the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Gross margin dollars decreased $62.6 million, while gross margin rate increased 40 basis points to 33.0% of net sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating loss rate increased 260 basis points to (10.7)%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter of Fiscal 2023, net sales increased 16%, as compared to the second quarter of Fiscal 2022, primarily due to an increase in higher unit selling and AUR.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The year-over-year increase in net sales reflects a positive comparable sales of 13%, as compared to the second quarter of Fiscal 2022, with growth in the Americas, EMEA and APAC segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: There have been no material changes in the Company’s contractual obligations since January 28, 2023, with the exception of those obligations which occurred in the normal course of business (primarily changes in the Company’s merchandise inventory-related purchases and lease obligations, which fluctuate throughout the year as a result of the seasonal nature of the Company’s operations).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Previously, the Company experienced inflationary pressures with respect to labor, cotton, freight and other raw materials and other costs, which has negatively impacted expenses and margins.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: A discussion of the Company’s financial condition, changes in financial condition and liquidity as of July 29, 2023, which includes (i) an analysis of financial condition as compared to January 28, 2023; (ii) an analysis of changes in cash flows for the twenty-six weeks ended July 29, 2023, as compared to the twenty-six weeks ended July 30, 2022; and (iii) an analysis of liquidity, including availability under the Company’s ABL Facility, the Company’s share repurchase program, and outstanding debt and covenant compliance.

records.title: 10-Q Q124 20230729
records.text: During the first quarter ended July 29, 2023, BNC First Day total revenue increased by $16.7 million, or 37%, to $61.7 million compared to $45.1 million during the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q Q124 20230729
records.text: Retail Gross Comparable Store Sales for general merchandise increased by 5.3% as discussed below.

records.title: 10-Q Q124 20230729
records.text: In Fiscal 2021 and Fiscal 2022, during the COVID-19 pandemic, the impact of fewer students on campus, and the resulting increase in transition to digital materials, has significantly impacted our on-campus buyback programs which supplies Wholesale’s used textbook inventory for future selling periods.

records.title: 10-Q Q124 20230729
records.text: Offering course materials through our equitable and inclusive access First Day Complete and First Day models is a key, and increasingly important strategic initiative of ours to meet the market demands of substantially reduced pricing to students, as well as the opportunity to improve student outcomes, while, at the same time, increasing our market share, revenue and relative gross profits of course material sales given the higher volumes of units sold in such models as compared to historical sales models that rely on individual student marketing and sales.

records.title: 10-Q Q124 20230729
records.text: Our operating loss was $(41.7) million during the 13 weeks ended July 29, 2023, compared to operating loss of $(45.6) million during the 13 weeks ended July 30, 2022.
